The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b2a7d738f44a3d34), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The manuscript presents this as a result of other work, which it uses; the attribution names that work in the manuscript's own words. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X, ∆) be a normal projective complex klt pair of dimension four, with effective rational boundary, and set D = KX + ∆. Suppose that for a projective birational morphism f : Z → X with Z smooth and some positive integer r with rD Cartier, the bundle f∗OX(rD) carries a semipositive singular Hermitian metric with zero Lelong numbers at every point of Z. If κ(X, D) ≥ 0, then D is semiample.
